sources.title: Reconcile bank statements by using advanced bank reconciliation
sources.scope: Validate the bank statement and Reconcile the bank statement sections; actual full page retrieved/read.
supported_claims: The product validates account/currency, previous closing continuity, statement and line dates, and opening plus line amounts equals closing.
A reconciliation worksheet uses cutoff dates, matched/unmatched transactions, grouped matching and tolerated penny differences.
sources.limitations: Product-specific, feature-dependent behavior, not an accounting standard. This sample JSON is not a Finance import format. Product posting, journals, reversals and payments are excluded.

sources.title: Set up bank reconciliation matching rules
sources.scope: Introduction and Set up bank reconciliation matching rule sets; actual full page retrieved/read.
supported_claims: The product's default may select the first matching bank document.
A documented parameter requires manual matching for multiple documents matching on amount.
Rule sets execute rules in a specified sequence.
sources.limitations: This sample deliberately chooses ambiguity review, not the first-match default. Exact batch manifests and whole-component holds are stronger fictional policies.

sources.title: Advanced bank reconciliation setup process
sources.scope: Transaction code mapping, Cash and bank management parameters, and Bank account reconciliation options; actual full page retrieved/read.
supported_claims: Account-specific transaction-type mappings and date-difference controls constrain matching.
The documented configuration includes penny tolerance, sign orientation, and time-zone interpretation.
sources.limitations: No universal threshold or verified native Finance/bank integration follows from this page. Synthetic fixed-offset dates do not implement daylight-saving or business-day calendars.
